1: # b1t-Sched - Academic Task Scheduler
2: 
3: > **Academic Task Scheduler** - A modern Single Page Application (SPA) designed for university students, class representatives (CRs), and faculty members to organize and track academic tasks, routines, assignments, exams, and notices with department-specific personalization.
4: 
5: <div align="center">
6:   <img src="Social-Preview.webp" width="220px" alt="b1t-Sched Logo" style="border-radius: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
7:   <h1>👉 <a href="https://github.com/b1tranger/b1t-Sched/blob/main/doc/DOCUMENTATION.md">Complete Documentation</a> 👈</h1>
8:   <p>
9:     <strong>Current Version:</strong> <code>v2.53.0 to v2.53.14</code> • 
10:     <strong>Architecture:</strong> Vanilla JS SPA + Firebase Firestore & Auth + PWA
11:   </p>
12: </div>
13: 
14: ---
15: 
16: ## ✨ Features Overview
17: 
18: ### 🔐 Authentication & Role Management
19: - **Flexible Credential Login**: Students can log in with their Student ID (normalized across string, numeric, and formatted inputs with dashes/spaces) or Email. Faculty can log in with their Faculty ID, initials (case-insensitive), or Email.
20: - **Segmented Role Toggles**: Dedicated Student and Faculty login tabs with strict cross-role enforcement (prevents student accounts from authenticating via the faculty tab and vice versa).
21: - **Onboarding Role Lockdown**: After initial signup, role identity is locked on the details setup screen, ensuring students cannot bypass section assignments or switch to faculty post-registration.
22: - **6-Tier Role System**:
23:   1. `Student` - View personalized section tasks, export tasks, take markdown notes, and sync personal Google Classroom assignments.
24:   2. `CR` (Class Representative) - Create, edit, and manage section tasks, deadlines, and group notices.
25:   3. `Faculty` - Create and manage departmental tasks, access Faculty Classroom, and post department-wide notices.
26:   4. `DptCoor` (Department Coordinator) - Faculty privileges plus account review, approvals, and role elevation within their department.
27:   5. `DptHead` (Department Head) - Comprehensive departmental oversight and coordinator capabilities.
28:   6. `Admin` - Complete platform administration, user management, account approvals, role assignments, UID lookups, and the **Admin Role Preview Mode** (simulate any role with a real-time floating indicator).
29: - **Faculty Self-Registration & Approvals**: Faculty self-register with pending status until approved by an Admin or Department Coordinator via the interactive Approvals modal.
30: 
31: ### 📋 Task Management & Productivity
32: - **Personalized Task Feed**: Automatic task filtering based on Department, Semester, and Section Group (`A1+A2`, `B1+B2`, etc.).
33: - **Overdue Grace Period**: Retains tasks in the active feed for a 12-hour grace period after the deadline passes before archiving.
34: - **Desktop Single-Row Layout**: Coordinated action row for `Add Tasks`, `View Old`, and `Reset Tasks` on desktop screens.
35: - **Mobile-Responsive Task Actions & Filters**:
36:   - Compact button labels on mobile (`Add`, `Old`, `Reset`).
37:   - Mobile compact dropdown filter (`Filters: [Set Filter] [Clear]`) synchronized bi-directionally with desktop radio pill buttons.
38: - **Task Identification**: Copyable Firebase Task UIDs and timestamps for reliable reference and verification.
39: 
40: ### 🛡️ Live Feeds & External Integrations
41: - **UITS Event Raiders Syndication**: Live syndication of hackathons, contests, symposiums, and tech events from `ou1ts/events` RSS/JSON feeds with desktop sticky sidebar integration and mobile toggle view switchers.
42: - **Google Classroom Integration**:
43:   - Unified course stream showing assignments, materials, and announcements with OAuth session persistence.
44:   - 3-group status layout (**Assigned**, **Missing**, **Turned In / Graded**) with chronological upcoming deadline priority and "Past deadline" visual divider banners.
45:   - Strict turn-in verification for automatic task completion.
46:   - Decoupled Classroom sync briefing summaries and quick announcement/assignment posting for Faculty and CRs.
47: - **University & CR Notices**: Real-time section notices posted by CRs and department notices posted by Faculty, alongside a UCAM university notice viewer with inline PDF preview via a Vercel serverless backend.
48: 
49: ### 📝 Notes & Productivity Tools
50: - **Rich Markdown Notes**: Personal note-taking module with auto-save, search, formatting tools, and temporary file hosting (Catbox.moe / Tmpfiles.org).

6: 
7: Note: _This is a comprehensive record of the pair programming session covering Google Classroom sync briefing modal with git-diff view, decoupling task completion from classroom refresh, user management UID copy and deletion guidance, login screen redesign with segmented role tabs, desktop install prompt styling, pending task UI refinements, strict turn-in verification, modular JS architecture organization, multi-theme updates (Dark Mode blue accents, High Contrast neon green), cross-role login enforcement, faculty and student ID/initial login, and changelog modal responsive layout._
8: 
9: ---
10: 
11: ## Turn 1: . Classroom Sync Briefing Modal & GitHub Version Control Diff View
12: 
13: ### User Request
14: ```
15: @[d:\GitHub\[oU1TS]\b1t-Sched\js\classroom.js] for the classroom modal `sync` feature, when adding a task from classroom or updating an instruction / annnouncement caption, I want another modal briefing exactly which announcement was updated, instead of showing a plain js alert. I should be able to view the post through the link, and also view the changes side by side: whether a new file was added or a line was changed. The changes should look like version control view (commit history) in GitHub. The changes should show as a dropdown view when i click on a button manually.
16: ```
17: 
18: ### Thinking
19: - The user wants to replace plain JS `alert()` dialogs in Google Classroom sync (`syncAssignmentsToTasks`) with an interactive, rich modal (`#classroom-sync-modal`).
20: - The modal needs to brief which assignment / task / instruction was updated or added.
21: - Direct links should be provided (`View in Classroom`) to open the original post.
22: - Side-by-side or line-by-line version control diff view (matching GitHub commit history / pull request changes styling) should show:
23:   - Added / removed / changed lines in captions / instructions / descriptions.
24:   - Added / removed file attachments.
25:   - Property changes (Title, Deadline).
26: - Diffs should be collapsed by default inside a dropdown accordion that expands on manual button click ("View Changes").
27: - Implemented LCS algorithm in `computeLineDiff` for exact line-by-line diffing with line numbers and green/red indicators.
28: - Created `#classroom-sync-modal` in `index.html` and styled with GitHub-like diff themes in `css/classroom.css`.
29: - Updated `syncAssignmentsToTasks` in `js/classroom.js` to compute diffs and present the rich summary modal.
30: 
31: ### AI Response
32: Implemented the Classroom Sync Briefing Modal with GitHub-style version control diffs:
33: 1. **Sync Summary Modal (`#classroom-sync-modal`)**:
34:    - Replaced browser `alert()` popups with a dedicated modal summary.
35:    - Summarizes total added, updated, and up-to-date items with status badges.
36:    - Includes direct "View in Classroom" post links.
37: 2. **GitHub-Style Version Control Diff View**:
38:    - Line-by-line LCS diff with line numbers and green/red highlights.
39:    - Property changes (Title & Deadline).
40:    - Attachment & file changes.

1: # Walkthrough: Classroom Type Labels, Faculty Permissions & Profile Fixes
2: 
3: This walkthrough details the implementation and validation of the changes resolving the Classroom Task Update Summary modal item type badges, Faculty session auto-logout on token refreshes, Department notices permissions in `cr-notice.js`, and Faculty preview mode tasks and profile card `null` text removal.
4: 
5: ---
6: 
7: ## Changes Summary
8: 
9: ### 1. Classroom Feature (`js/features/classroom.js` & `css/classroom.css`)
10: - **Item Type Categorization**:
11:   - In `computeClassroomChanges()`, coursework items are tagged with `type: 'assignment'`, announcements with `type: 'announcement'`, and coursework materials with `type: 'material'`.
12:   - Added full diffing support for coursework materials across sync cycles (`prevMaterials` vs `freshMaterials`).
13:   - Passed `prevMaterials` and `freshMaterials` in `refreshData()` and `handleTokenResponse()`.
14: - **Sync Summary Badges & Pills**:
15:   - In `showSyncSummaryModal()`, replaced hardcoded `'Added Task'` with dynamic labels (`Added Announcement`, `Added Assignment`, `Added Material`, `Updated Announcement`, etc.).
16:   - Added dedicated type pills `<span class="sync-type-pill type-${itemType}">` with custom icons (`fa-bullhorn`, `fa-folder-open`, `fa-clipboard-list`).
17: - **Coursework Task Sync for Faculty**:
18:   - In `syncClassroomWorkToTasks()`, ensured `taskData.semester` and `taskData.section` are set to `null` and `addedByRole: 'Faculty'` when syncing as a faculty user or in faculty preview mode.
19: - **Styling**:
20:   - Added styles for `.sync-type-pill` in `css/classroom.css` with dedicated theme-aware color variants (`.type-assignment`, `.type-announcement`, `.type-material`).
21: 
22: ### 2. Core Authentication & Profile (`js/core/app.js` & `js/core/ui.js`)
23: - **Faculty Session Stability**:
24:   - In `handleLogin()`, set `this._isExplicitLoginAttempt = true` upon form submission.
25:   - In `handleAuthenticatedUser()`, restricted cross-role mismatch checks exclusively to explicit interactive logins (`this._isExplicitLoginAttempt`).
26:   - Synchronized `this.currentLoginRole = this.isFaculty ? 'faculty' : 'student'` and saved to local storage, preventing background token refreshes, tab refocus, or page reloads from triggering `Auth.logout()`.
27: - **Navbar Profile Card `null` Text Removal**:
28:   - In `UI.updateUserDetailsCard()`, filtered out `null`, `undefined`, and the string `'null'`, cleanly showing `${department}` (e.g. `CSE`) instead of `CSE • null • null`.
29: - **Admin Faculty Preview Mode Profile Display**:
30:   - In `applyPreviewRole('Faculty')`, updated the user details card to display department without semester/section (`UI.updateUserDetailsCard(email, dept, null, null)`).
31:   - In `applyPreviewRole('none')`, restored the user details card with the Admin's authentic semester and section.
32: - **Faculty Task Role Attribution**:
33:   - In `handleAddTask()`, passed `addedByRole: 'Faculty'` when `this.isFaculty` is active.
34: 
35: ### 3. Database Layer & Department Notices (`js/core/db.js`, `js/features/cr-notice.js` & `js/core/firestore-listener-manager.js`)
36: - **Faculty Tasks Loading**:
37:   - In `DB.getFacultyTasks()`, updated the query to `.where('department', '==', department).where('status', '==', 'active')` and added client-side filtering for tasks where `task.addedByRole === 'Faculty'` OR `(!task.semester && !task.section)` OR `(task.semester === 'null' && task.section === 'null')`.
38:   - Ensures tasks created in Faculty preview mode, Admin faculty tasks, and direct faculty tasks are loaded seamlessly.
39: - **Task Creation Role Attribution**:
40:   - In `DB.createTask()`, honored `data.addedByRole` if supplied, and set `addedByRole = 'Faculty'` when `App.previewRole === 'Faculty'` or when semester/section are `null`.

28: ---
29: 
30: ## Project Overview
31: 
32: ### Description
33: 
34: b1t-Sched is a web-based academic task scheduler designed for university students. It provides a personalized dashboard with tasks, events, and resource links filtered by the student's department, semester, and section.
35: 
36: ### Key Features
37: 
38: - **Single-Page Application (SPA)** - Hash-based routing for seamless navigation
39: - **Firebase Authentication** - Secure email/password login system with email verification and password reset
40: - **User Profiles** - Student ID, department, semester, and section
41: - **Personalized Dashboard** - Content filtered by user's academic details
42: - **Task Management** - View pending assignments and exams with deadlines (or "No official Time limit"), with enhanced markdown support (**bold**, _italic_, fenced code blocks, inline code, links), HTML entity rendering (e.g., \*, &times;), `<pre>` tag support for preserved formatting, clickable links, and collapsible descriptions (2-line truncation). "Set Deadline" is now the default option when adding tasks.
43: - **Task Completion** - Checkboxes to mark tasks complete, persistent per-user
44: - **Task Editing** - Users can edit their own tasks; admins can edit all tasks; Course is required field
45: - **Event Calendar** - Track upcoming academic events with enhanced markdown support (HTML entities, code blocks, `<pre>` tags), clickable links, collapsible descriptions (2-line truncation), and department scope badge (ALL/CSE/etc.)
46: - **Event Editing** - Admins can edit all events; CRs can edit/delete their own events
47: - **Resource Links** - Quick access to department-specific resources with built-in PDF viewer (desktop: Google Docs Viewer in modal; mobile: opens in new tab)
48: - **Google Classroom Integration** - View all assignments, announcements, and posted course materials from enrolled courses in a unified interface with OAuth authentication and session persistence (auto-refresh tokens & cached fallback mode). Features three view toggle tabs (**To-Do**, **Notices**, **Materials**), real-time assignment status badges (**Assigned** [Blue], **Missing** [Red], **Turned in** / **Turned in (Late)** [Green], and **Returned** / **Graded: X/Y** [Purple]), responsive mobile course view header (toggle buttons wrap cleanly to the 2nd line under the course title), default hiding of Archived Classrooms with an interactive toggle button, a unified pill-styled Sign Out button dynamically shown when logged in, seamless expired token recovery with a 1-click **Reconnect** banner (prevents popup flashes and blank screens), and a one-click **Sync to Tasks** feature for Admins/CRs to automatically add Classroom assignments to the main Tasks list (avoids duplicates).
49: - **Session Security** - Automatic logout after 1 hour of inactivity (unless "Stay logged in" is checked), with activity-based timer reset for enhanced security
50: - **Stay Logged In** - Optional "Trust this device" checkbox on login to persist session indefinitely on safe devices

411:     const deptNames = Object.keys(facultyTasksByDept).sort();
412:     deptNames.forEach(dept => {
413:       const deptTasks = sortTasks(facultyTasksByDept[dept]);
414:       if (deptTasks.length > 0) {
415:         html += `
416:           <div class="faculty-task-group">
417:             <div class="faculty-task-group-header">
418:               <i class="fas fa-chalkboard-teacher"></i>
419:               <span>Faculty Tasks - ${dept}</span>
420:             </div>
421:             ${deptTasks.map(task => this.renderTaskCard(task, userCompletions, isAdmin, isCR, currentUserId, now, true)).join('')}
422:           </div>
423:         `;
424:       }
425:     });
426: 
427:     // Render other tasks
428:     html += sortedOtherTasks.map(task => this.renderTaskCard(task, userCompletions, isAdmin, isCR, currentUserId, now, false)).join('');
429: 
430:     container.innerHTML = html;
431:   },
432: 
433:   // Helper function to render a single task card
434:   renderTaskCard(task, userCompletions, isAdmin, isCR, currentUserId, now, isFacultyTask) {
435:     let deadline = null;
436:     let daysUntil = null;
437:     let isUrgent = false;
438:     let isPastDeadline = false;
439:     if (task.deadline) {
440:       deadline = task.deadline.toDate ? task.deadline.toDate() : new Date(task.deadline);
441:       daysUntil = Math.ceil((deadline - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
442:       isUrgent = daysUntil <= 3 && daysUntil > 0;
443:       isPastDeadline = deadline < now;
444:     }
445:     const isCompleted = userCompletions[task.id] || false;
446:     // Determine task status class
447:     let statusClass = '';
448:     if (isCompleted) {
449:       statusClass = 'completed';
450:     } else if (isPastDeadline) {
451:       statusClass = 'incomplete';
452:     }
453:     // Edit: Admin can edit any task, Faculty can edit their own tasks, users can only edit their own tasks
454:     const canEdit = isAdmin || (currentUserId && task.addedBy === currentUserId);
455:     const editButton = canEdit ? `
456:         <button class="task-edit-btn" data-task-id="${task.id}" title="Edit task">
457:           <i class="fas fa-edit"></i>
458:         </button>
459:       ` : '';
460:     // Delete: Admin/CR can delete any task, users can only delete their own tasks
461:     const canDelete = isAdmin || isCR || (currentUserId && task.addedBy === currentUserId);
462:     const deleteButton = canDelete ? `
463:         <button class="task-delete-btn" data-task-id="${task.id}" title="Delete task">
464:           <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
465:         </button>
466:       ` : '';
467: 
468:     // Add Faculty badge if this is a Faculty task
469:     const facultyBadge = isFacultyTask ? `<span class="task-faculty-badge"><i class="fas fa-chalkboard-teacher"></i> Faculty</span>` : '';
470: 
471:     // Add Classroom badge if added from Classroom
472:     const classroomBadge = task.addedFrom === 'classroom' ? `<span class="task-type-badge assignment" style="background-color: #34a853; color: white; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;"><i class="fas fa-chalkboard-teacher"></i> Classroom</span>` : '';
473: 
474:     return `
475:         <div class="task-card ${statusClass} ${isFacultyTask ? 'faculty-task' : ''}" data-task-id="${task.id}" data-type="${task.type || 'other'}">
476:           <div class="task-card-inner">
477:             <div class="task-checkbox-wrapper">
478:               <input type="checkbox" class="task-checkbox" 
479:                      data-task-id="${task.id}" 
480:                      ${isCompleted ? 'checked' : ''}
481:                      title="${isCompleted ? 'Mark as incomplete' : 'Mark as complete'}">
482:             </div>
483:             <div class="task-content">
484:               <div class="task-header">
485:                 <div>
486:                   <p class="task-course">${task.course || 'No course specified'}</p>
487:                   <h3 class="task-title">${task.title || ''}</h3>
488:                 </div>
489:                 <div class="task-header-right">
490:                   <div class="task-header-actions-row">
491:                     ${facultyBadge}
492:                     <span class="task-type-badge ${task.type}">${task.type || 'task'}</span>
493:                     <button type="button" class="task-card-copy-btn" data-task-id="${task.id}" title="Copy task contents" aria-label="Copy task contents">
494:                       <i class="far fa-copy"></i>
495:                     </button>

Updated documentation to reflect user's approval and decisions. The implementation will be synchronized across `implementation_plan.md` and related documentation. Initial focus is on Phase A, specifically addressing the critical fixes and PWA polish items identified in the backlog.


Updated the service worker cache to include the new icon assets. Implemented the back-button login redirect by adding an authentication guard to the router and utilizing `history.replaceState` during login and state loading. Added a live countdown ticker to the notice refresh button on both desktop and mobile, along with cooldown status text in the mobile drawer.


Removed layout-shifting CSS rule from timeline modal to stabilize touch target on mobile devices. Implemented blob download for file links within note previews, falling back to window open if CORS restrictions are encountered. Addressed mobile input zoom and overflow issues by setting appropriate font sizes, disabling overscroll behavior, and preventing horizontal overflow. Enabled the "forgot password" link to appear after two minutes of idle time on the login view. Updated the authorization rules to permit department coordinators to modify faculty tasks within their respective departments.


Updated logic to grant department coordinators edit/delete rights on faculty tasks within their departments. Refined the task cleanup process to include options for either administrative/CR deletion or automatic deletion of tasks lacking deadlines after the current semester. Implemented client-side visitor mode, including a "Browse as Visitor" button, static dummy data, and read-only features, to ensure no Firebase interactions. Organized documentation into feature, architecture, limitations/deprecated, and archive folders for improved structure.

Currently, the interface doesn't reflect the cooldown period after a forced refresh; instead, it immediately presents the refresh button. </details>

*Created at: 2026-11-13T06:04:51Z*

<details><summary>Thinking</summary>

The expand button's functionality is to toggle the visibility of the full snippet by adding and removing a CSS class. Initially, the CSS intended to handle this expansion, setting `display: inline` for the full snippet. However, the existing CSS rules on the parent element, specifically `white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;`, were overriding the intended display, preventing the full snippet from showing. This explains the truncated text, even when the expanded state is active.




</details>

The existing handler directly opens the link in a new tab; no download attempt is present. To trigger a direct download on a file link click, the filename must first be extracted from the URL or link text. Then, it needs to be checked if the URL is a known download link, such as those on `files.catbox.moe`, `tmpfiles.org`, or `file.io`, or that the link ends in a known file extension.

<summary>
### 1. Task Overview
- **User Goals & Core Requests**:
  1. Always-present `+` shortcut button above Google Classroom modal (`index.html:L982-L1011`) to open the classroom website (**Completed** in Turn 1).
  2. Add GitHub repo link as icon-only button in the top bar; on mobile footer (`index.html:L2440-L2454`), show only icons for Source Code and What's New while keeping full credits (**Completed** in Turn 1).
  3. Formulate an implementation plan addressing a 20-item backlog (`20` down to `1`), audited against repo `v2.53.15` (**Completed** & user-approved with specific comments in Turn 2).
- **User Feedback & Scope Decisions on Implementation Plan**:
  - **#19 (No-deadline tasks)**: Make it Admin/CR deletion or auto-deletion after that semester (do not just keep them forever).
  - **#16 (Forgot Password)**: Show it after 2 minutes of idle time on the login view (in addition to showing immediately upon failed password entry).
  - **#18 (Visitor Mode)**: Keep separate client-side dummy data (not loaded from Firebase/backend); profile window displays "Visitor" information. Zero Firebase calls.
  - **#10, #13, #14 (Safrid NLP), #16 (gallery error)**: Deferred / ignored for now.
- **Deliverables**: Phased implementation of Batch 1 (Critical Fixes & PWA Polish), Batch 2 (Role/Permissions & Feature Additions), Batch 3 (Doc Reorganization & References in `doc/DOCUMENTATION.md`).

   - `index.html`: Wrapped link labels in `<span class="footer-link-text">` for `Source Code` and `What's New`.
   - `css/main.css`: Added `@media (max-width: 768px) { .app-footer .footer-link-text { display: none; } .app-footer i { margin-right: 0; } }`.

### 3. Key Findings & Decisions
- **Mobile Zoom Quirk**: `App.adjustMobileZoom()` uses `document.body.style.zoom = '95%'`, which interacts poorly with `100vh` on iOS/Android; using `100dvh` and explicit `16px` form inputs eliminates viewport overflow and zooming.
- **PWA Desktop Icons**: Desktop PWA installation requires PNG formats with standard square sizes (192 and 512). WebP-only declarations in `manifest.json` cause missing icons in Windows taskbars and macOS docks.
- **Visitor Mode Architecture**: Per user direction, must be **purely client-side** dummy data (`js/features/visitor-data.js`). Do not call `signInAnonymously()` or read Firestore. Profile card and settings will show "Visitor" state.
- **Task Deletion for No-Deadline Tasks**: In `DB.resetOldTasks()`, allow Admin/CR to delete tasks where `deadline === null` if created before the current semester / older than 6 months.
- **DptCoor Task Permissions**: Firestore rules currently restrict `/tasks/{taskId}` update/delete to `isAdmin()` or `resource.data.addedBy == request.auth.uid`. Need to add `isDptCoor()` permission for tasks within the same department.

---

### 4. Errors & Fixes
1. *PowerShell Wildcard Error*: PowerShell wildcard expansion failed on directory name `[oU1TS]` because brackets represent character classes.
   - *Fix*: Always use `-LiteralPath 'd:\GitHub\[oU1TS]\b1t-Sched'` or wrap paths safely.
2. *PowerShell Variable Escaping in run_command*: Inline script with `\"` escaped variables like `$ico.Width` caused parser errors.
   - *Fix*: Wrote a clean standalone `.ps1` script (`scratch/extract_icon.ps1`) and executed via `-File`.
3. *WPF PngBitmapEncoder Constructor*: `New-Object System.Windows.Media.Imaging.PngBitmapEncoder()` failed due to trailing parentheses syntax in PowerShell.
   - *Fix*: Removed parentheses (`New-Object System.Windows.Media.Imaging.PngBitmapEncoder`).
4. *Working Tree Uncommitted Text*: `git diff` showed line 1809 of `js/features/classroom.js` had `fa-New Class Announcement / Assignment` from a prior workspace state. Avoided touching unrelated lines to preserve user's working tree edits.

---

- **Icons Extracted**: `images/icon-192x192.png`, `images/icon-512x512.png`, `images/apple-touch-icon.png` (present and verified in `images/` and `images/icons/`).
- **Dependencies**: No external npm packages required (vanilla JS architecture).

### 6. Next Steps (In Priority Order)

#### Step 1: Complete Forgot Password 2-Min Idle Timer (#16 sub-item 2)
- In `js/core/app.js`:
  - Add `forgotPasswordIdleTimer: null`, `startForgotPasswordIdleTimer()`, and `clearForgotPasswordIdleTimer()` methods.
  - Set a 120,000 ms timer that reveals `#forgot-password-container` with class `.visible`.
  - Trigger `startForgotPasswordIdleTimer()` in `handleUnauthenticatedUser()` and on login form interaction.
  - Trigger `clearForgotPasswordIdleTimer()` on login submit and route change away from `login`.

#### Step 2: DptCoor Modifying Other Faculty Tasks (#17)
- In `firestore.rules`:
  - In `match /tasks/{taskId}`, update `allow update, delete` to permit `isDptCoor()` when `resource.data.department == getUserDepartment()` and `(resource.data.addedByRole == 'Faculty' || resource.data.semester == null)`.
- In `js/core/ui.js` & `js/core/app.js`:
  - Update `renderTaskCard`: allow `canEdit` and `canDelete` if `isDptCoor` is true, task is in user's department, and task is a faculty task.
  - Update `openEditTaskModal` and `handleDeleteTask` to permit `isDptCoor` under the same conditions.

#### Step 3: Admin/CR Deletion of No-Deadline Old Tasks (#19 sub-item 2)
- In `js/core/db.js` (`DB.resetOldTasks`):
  - Add support to delete no-deadline tasks (`task.deadline == null`) if created before the active semester threshold or when explicitly requested by Admin/CR during reset.

#### Step 5: Uni Notice Firestore Persistence & Mobile Notifications Fix (#6 sub-item 1 & #14 sub-item 3)
- In `js/notifications/notification-manager.js`:
  - Check `navigator.serviceWorker.ready` directly instead of requiring `navigator.serviceWorker.controller` to avoid missing notifications on first load.
- In `js/features/notice.js`:
  - When Admin/CR refreshes notices from backend, mirror the notice cache to Firestore document `metadata/uni_notices` so subsequent users load instantly without Vercel cold starts.

#### Step 6: Desktop Login Window Optimization (#4) & Resolution Breakpoints (#9)

# Chat Conversation - 36. Classroom Shortcut FAB, Navbar GitHub Button & Mobile Footer Icons

Note: _This is a comprehensive record of the pair programming session covering making the Google Classroom `+` floating shortcut button always visible above the Classroom modal and mobile sidebar, adding an icon-only GitHub repository button to the top navigation bar, and compacting the mobile footer links to icons only while preserving full credits._

---

## Turn 1: Always-Visible Classroom `+` Shortcut, Navbar GitHub Icon Button & Mobile Footer Icons

### User Request
```
1. the button with `+` icon for @[d:\GitHub\[oU1TS]\b1t-Sched\index.html:L982-L1011] should be always present above the classroom modal. The goal is to have a shortcut to open the classroom website.

2. add the GitHub repository link to the top bar with the github icon onlyas button. for mobile display, show only the icons here @[d:\GitHub\[oU1TS]\b1t-Sched\index.html:L2440-L2454] (keep the credits in full)
```

### Thinking
1. **Always-Present Classroom `+` Shortcut Button**:
   - Located `#classroom-create-btn-mobile` and `#classroom-create-btn-desktop` (`.classroom-create-fab`, `z-index: 1200`) inside `#classroom-sidebar` and `#classroom-modal` in `index.html`.
   - Previously, both buttons had inline `style="display: none;"` and `Classroom.updateCreateButtonVisibility()` in `js/features/classroom.js` hid them unless the user was both connected to Google Classroom and a Faculty/CR/Admin (`isFacultyOrCR()`).
   - Removed `style="display: none;"` in `index.html`, updated `title` and `aria-label` to `"Open Google Classroom"`, and updated `Classroom.updateCreateButtonVisibility()` to always set `display = 'flex'` on both buttons so every user has an always-present shortcut above the Classroom modal/sidebar to open `#classroom-create-modal` and redirect to Google Classroom.
2. **Top Navbar GitHub Icon-Only Button**:
   - Added `<a href="https://github.com/b1tranger/b1t-Sched" ... class="nav-github-btn">` with `<i class="fab fa-github">` inside `.nav-right` in `index.html`, right beside `#user-details-card` so it remains visible on both desktop and mobile top bars.
   - Styled `.nav-github-btn` and `.nav-right` gap in `css/navbar.css` with circular icon button sizing (`38px` desktop, `34px` mobile) and dedicated Light, Dark, and Gray mode contrast overrides.
3. **Mobile Footer Icons Only (Full Credits Kept)**:
   - Wrapped `Source Code` and `What's New` labels inside `<span class="footer-link-text">` in `#app-footer` (`index.html`), added accessible `title`/`aria-label` attributes, and kept `Â© <span id="footer-year"></span> @b1tranger` intact.
   - Added `@media (max-width: 768px)` rules in `css/main.css` to hide `.app-footer .footer-link-text` and zero out `.app-footer i` right margin so only the icons render on mobile while credits remain in full.

<details><summary>Thinking</summary>

The `#forgot-password-container` should be made visible. The initial understanding is that it appears either after two minutes of inactivity on the login view or immediately upon an incorrect password entry. The class `.visible` controls the display behavior.


The login view utilizes an idle timer. The timer is cleared upon successful login or navigation away. The timer starts when the user lands on the login route. The expectation is that the forgot password container appears after two minutes of inactivity on the login view.

The idle timer must reset upon user interaction on the login form. The forgot password container should display only after 120,000 milliseconds of inactivity. This definition of "idle time" requires the timer to be reset on `input` and `keydown` events within the login form.




</details>

## Project Overview

### Description

b1t-Sched is a web-based academic task scheduler designed for university students. It provides a personalized dashboard with tasks, events, and resource links filtered by the student's department, semester, and section.

### Key Features

- **Single-Page Application (SPA)** - Hash-based routing for seamless navigation
- **Firebase Authentication** - Secure email/password login system with email verification and password reset
- **User Profiles** - Student ID, department, semester, and section

- **Segmented Role Toggles**: Dedicated Student and Faculty login tabs with strict cross-role enforcement (prevents student accounts from authenticating via the faculty tab and vice versa).
- **Onboarding Role Lockdown**: After initial signup, role identity is locked on the details setup screen, ensuring students cannot bypass section assignments or switch to faculty post-registration.
- **6-Tier Role System**:
  1. `Student` - View personalized section tasks, export tasks, take markdown notes, and sync personal Google Classroom assignments.
  2. `CR` (Class Representative) - Create, edit, and manage section tasks, deadlines, and group notices.
  3. `Faculty` - Create and manage departmental tasks, access Faculty Classroom, and post department-wide notices.
  4. `DptCoor` (Department Coordinator) - Faculty privileges plus account review, approvals, and role elevation within their department.
  5. `DptHead` (Department Head) - Comprehensive departmental oversight and coordinator capabilities.
  6. `Admin` - Complete platform administration, user management, account approvals, role assignments, UID lookups, and the **Admin Role Preview Mode** (simulate any role with a real-time floating indicator).
- **Faculty Self-Registration & Approvals**: Faculty self-register with pending status until approved by an Admin or Department Coordinator via the interactive Approvals modal.

### ðŸ“‹ Task Management & Productivity
- **Personalized Task Feed**: Automatic task filtering based on Department, Semester, and Section Group (`A1+A2`, `B1+B2`, etc.).

- **Desktop Single-Row Layout**: Coordinated action row for `Add Tasks`, `View Old`, and `Reset Tasks` on desktop screens.

#### Content:
All approved backlog items and adjustments have been implemented, verified, and documented under **v2.53.16**.

### Summary of Completed Work

1. **Visitor Mode (Client-Side Only Preview)**:
   - Added [js/features/visitor-data.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/features/visitor-data.js) containing static mock tasks, events, notices, and user profile data.
   - Zero Firebase/Firestore network or auth calls are executed when running in Visitor Mode.
   - Added a `Browse as Visitor (Preview)` button on `#login-view` and a floating `#visitor-preview-banner` in [index.html](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/index.html).
   - In [js/core/app.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/app.js), implemented `startVisitorMode()` and `exitVisitorMode()`, and guarded write operations (`handleAddTask`, `openEditTaskModal`, `handleDeleteTask`, `handleResetTasks`, `loadDashboardData`).
   - Allowed in-memory interactive task completions for demo purposes.
   - In [js/features/profile.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/features/profile.js), displayed `"Visitor Guest"` and a `"Visitor"` role badge, with profile edits disabled.

2. **Department Coordinator Permissions**:
   - Updated [firestore.rules](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/firestore.rules) to permit `(isDptCoor() && resource.data.department == getUserDepartment())` on task updates and deletions.
   - Updated [js/core/ui.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/ui.js) (`renderTasks`, `renderTaskCard`, and `renderOldTasks`) to display edit and delete buttons on faculty tasks within the Department Coordinator's department.
   - Updated `openEditTaskModal()` and `handleDeleteTask()` in [js/core/app.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/app.js) to enforce coordinator authorization.

3. **No-Deadline Tasks Cleanup & Auto-Deletion**:
   - In [js/core/db.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/db.js) (`resetOldTasks`), removed the unconditional skip of tasks with no deadlines. Added support for `includeNoDeadline` and automatic deletion of no-deadline tasks older than one semester (180 days).
   - In [js/core/app.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/app.js) (`handleResetTasks`), added confirmation prompts allowing Admin and CR to choose whether to delete no-deadline tasks during resets.

4. **Forgot Password 2-Minute Inactivity Trigger**:
   - Implemented `startForgotPasswordIdleTimer()` and `clearForgotPasswordIdleTimer()` in [js/core/app.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/app.js) that reveals `#forgot-password-container` after 2 minutes of inactivity on the login view.
   - Resets the timer on `login-form` input events, clearing it on login submission or navigation away from `login`.
   - Maintained immediate display upon incorrect password entry.

5. **Mobile Notification Service Worker Priority**:
   - Updated `showTaskNotification()`, `showEventNotification()`, and `showNoticeNotification()` in [js/notifications/notification-manager.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/notifications/notification-manager.js) to check `'serviceWorker' in navigator` and await `navigator.serviceWorker.ready` directly, resolving `TypeError: Illegal constructor` exceptions thrown by mobile browsers when calling `new Notification(...)`.

6. **University Notices Firestore Metadata Caching**:
   - In [js/features/notice.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/features/notice.js), added pre-fetch checks against Firestore document `metadata/uni_notices`, enabling instant loading on student devices without waiting for cold backend wakeups.
   - Whenever an Admin refreshes notices, the top 50 notices are automatically mirrored to `metadata/uni_notices`.

7. **Desktop Login Window Styling & Resolution Scaling**:
   - In [css/main.css](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/css/main.css), styled `.auth-card` on desktop screens (`min-width: 992px`) with an elevated container, border, shadow, and responsive spacing.
   - In [js/core/app.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/app.js), refined `adjustMobileZoom()` to dynamically configure `--app-scale` across mobile, tablet, and widescreen breakpoints.

8. **Documentation Directory Index & Design References**:
   - Created [doc/README.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/README.md) cataloging features, setup guides, limitations, and prompt archives.
   - In [doc/DOCUMENTATION.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/DOCUMENTATION.md) (Section 17), added citations and design inspirations (ClickUp, Google Calendar, GitHub, and analytical bar charts), along with an inventory of all client libraries and documentation on why Firebase Cloud Storage bucket uploads were reverted in favor of Catbox/Tmpfiles.

   - Incremented cache version to `v2.53.16` in [sw.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/sw.js) and added `visitor-data.js` to static cache assets.

### Step 748 (MODEL - PLANNER_RESPONSE)
*Created at: 2026-11-13T06:39:41Z*

#### Content:
### 1. Tracking the Current Semester

The repository tracks the current academic semester using two complementary systems:

#### A. Academic Calendar Engine (`js/core/utils.js`)
University academic calendars (including UITS) operate on two standard biannual cycles:
* **Spring Semester (`YYYY-01`)**: Runs from **January 1 to June 30**. Ends on **June 30 at 23:59:59**.
* **Fall Semester (`YYYY-07`)**: Runs from **July 1 to December 31**. Ends on **December 31 at 23:59:59**.

We added two helper methods to [js/core/utils.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/utils.js):
```javascript
// Returns the exact Date object for the end of the semester of any given date
Utils.getSemesterEnd(date = new Date())
```
```javascript
// Returns a comprehensive active semester payload:
Utils.getCurrentSemesterInfo(date = new Date())
// -> {
//      cycle: "2026-07",
//      name: "Fall 2026",
//      season: "Fall",
//      year: 2026,
//      startDate: Date(2026-07-01),
//      endDate: Date(2026-12-31T23:59:59.999),
//      daysRemaining: 48,
//      isExpired: false
//    }
```

#### B. Administrative Firestore Metadata (`metadata/semesterConfig`)
* Admins record official bulk semester promotions in Firestore doc `metadata/semesterConfig` with `{ lastCycle, lastBulkUpdate, updatedBy }`.
* Each user document in Firestore (`/users/{userId}`) maintains their currently enrolled semester (e.g. `semester: '5th'`) and tracks `lastSemesterCycle`.

---

### 2. Auto-Completion Pipeline (Replacing Auto-Deletion)

Tasks without an explicit deadline are **never deleted**. Instead, they transition into auto-completed state when their semester concludes:

1. **Default Semester Deadline**:
   - In [js/core/app.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/app.js) (`handleAddTask` and `handleEditTask`), when "No Deadline" is selected, the task's deadline is automatically assigned to `Utils.getSemesterEnd(new Date())` with `isNoDeadline: true`.
   - In [js/core/ui.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/ui.js) (`renderTaskCard`), tasks without explicit deadlines display `Due: End of Semester (Date)` (e.g., `Due: End of Semester (31 Dec 2026)`) rather than an arbitrary time.

2. **Auto-Completion on Reset**:
   - In [js/core/db.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/db.js) (`resetOldTasks`), no-deadline tasks are **excluded from deletion**.
   - If the task's semester has concluded (`now > semesterEnd`) or if the Admin/CR confirms auto-completing current no-deadline tasks, Firestore updates them with `isCompleted: true, autoCompleted: true, completedAt: Timestamp.fromDate(semesterEnd)`.
   - Expired tasks with explicit past deadlines are removed as usual.

3. **Dashboard Auto-Resolution**:
   - In [js/core/app.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/app.js) (`loadDashboardData`), any tasks from ended semesters without an explicit deadline are automatically marked as completed in `this.userCompletions`, ensuring students and visitors see past-semester tasks cleanly archived in Completed / View Old Tasks.

---

<summary>
### 1. Task Overview
- **Core Requests & User Goals**:
  1. Fix footer links showing doubled / duplicated in `#app-footer` (`index.html`).
  2. For mobile display (`<= 768px`), show only the icons for the footer links (`Source Code` and `What's New`) while keeping the full credits (`© <year> @b1tranger`) completely intact.
  3. Change "No-Deadline Tasks Cleanup & Auto-Deletion" to **auto-completion** instead of auto-deletion. Every task without an explicit deadline defaults its deadline to the end of that semester (Spring: June 30, Fall: December 31).
  4. Track the current semester deterministically and administratively.
- **Scope & Boundaries**:
  - No-deadline tasks must **never** be auto-deleted; when their semester concludes (`now > semesterEnd`), they auto-complete.
  - Visitor mode remains client-side only (zero Firebase network or auth calls).
  - Research/external items (#10 Gemini API, #13 FTTE/VPS, #14 Safrid NLP, #16 gallery error) remain deferred/ignored per user direction.

---

### 2. Progress
- **Completed & Verified**:
  1. **Footer Links Duplication Fix (`index.html:L2561-L2577`)**:
     - Identified that `index.html` contained malformed nested `<a>` tags (`<a href="..." <a href="..."`) and duplicate inner text/icons for both Source Code and What's New.
     - Cleaned markup to single semantic anchor tags:
       ```html
       <footer id="app-footer" class="app-footer" style="display: none;">
           <p>
               © <span id="footer-year"></span>
               <a href="https://github.com/b1tranger" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">@b1tranger</a>
               <span class="footer-separator">|</span>
               <a href="https://github.com/b1tranger/b1t-Sched" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                   title="Source Code" aria-label="Source Code">
                   <i class="fab fa-github" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="footer-link-text"> Source Code</span>
               </a>
               <span class="footer-separator">|</span>
               <a href="#" id="footer-changelog-link" title="What's New" aria-label="What's New"
                   onclick="if(window.ChangelogModal){window.ChangelogModal.checkAndShowChangelog(true);}return false;">
                   <i class="fas fa-bullhorn" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="footer-link-text"> What's New</span>
               </a>
           </p>
       </footer>
       ```
  2. **Mobile Footer Icons-Only Styling (`css/main.css:L1254-L1275`)**:
     - Added `@media (max-width: 768px)` rules enforcing `.app-footer .footer-link-text { display: none !important; }`.
     - Centered inline-flex anchors with touch targets (`padding: 2px 4px;`) and font size (`15px`) while removing icon right margins (`.app-footer i { margin-right: 0 !important; }`).
     - Kept full credits `© <span id="footer-year"></span> @b1tranger` visible in full.
  3. **Semester Tracking Engine (`js/core/utils.js:L318-L382`)**:
     - Implemented `Utils.getSemesterEnd(date = new Date())` returning `June 30 23:59:59.999` for Spring (`YYYY-01`) and `December 31 23:59:59.999` for Fall (`YYYY-07`).
     - Implemented `Utils.getCurrentSemesterInfo(date = new Date())` returning cycle tag, name, season, start/end dates, days remaining, and expiration flag.
  4. **No-Deadline Default Semester Deadline (`js/core/app.js` & `js/core/ui.js`)**:
     - In `handleAddTask()` and `handleEditTask()`, selecting "No Deadline" sets `isNoDeadline: true` and defaults `deadline = Utils.getSemesterEnd(new Date())`.
     - In `openEditTaskModal()`, tasks with `isNoDeadline` or without a deadline preserve the "No Deadline" radio state upon opening.
     - In `UI.renderTaskCard()` (`js/core/ui.js:L435-L540`), tasks without explicit deadlines display `Due: End of Semester (${Utils.formatDate(deadline)})` and sort after explicit-deadline tasks.
  5. **Auto-Completion Instead of Auto-Deletion (`js/core/db.js` & `js/core/app.js`)**:
     - In `DB.resetOldTasks()`, removed all auto-deletion of no-deadline tasks. If `now > semesterEnd` (or when requested by Admin/CR during reset), tasks are auto-completed via `batch.update(doc.ref, { isCompleted: true, autoCompleted: true, completedAt: Timestamp.fromDate(semesterEnd) })`.
     - In `App.loadDashboardData()`, automatically checks `this.currentTasks` and populates `this.userCompletions[task.id]` as completed for any past-semester tasks without explicit deadlines.
     - In `App.handleResetTasks()`, updated confirmation dialogs and alerts to report auto-completed vs deleted expired tasks.
  6. **Visitor Mode (`js/features/visitor-data.js`, `index.html`, `js/core/app.js`, `js/features/profile.js`)**:
     - Completed and verified with client-side static mock tasks, events, notices, and profile.
  7. **Department Coordinator Permissions (`firestore.rules`, `js/core/ui.js`, `js/core/app.js`)**:
     - Rules and UI updated so `isDptCoor` can edit and delete matching department faculty tasks.
  8. **Forgot Password 2-Min Idle Timer (`js/core/app.js`)**:
     - Implemented 120,000ms inactivity timer revealing `#forgot-password-container`.
  9. **Mobile Notification Constructor Fix (`js/notifications/notification-manager.js`)**:
     - Direct Service Worker registration priority before desktop `new Notification()` fallback.
  10. **Uni Notices Firestore Metadata CDN Caching (`js/features/notice.js`)**:
      - Pre-checked `metadata/uni_notices` for instant loading without cold backend wakeups.
  11. **Desktop Login Window & Resolution Scaling (`css/main.css`, `js/core/app.js`)**:
      - Styled desktop elevated login card and fine-grained `--app-scale` breakpoints.
  12. **Documentation & Version History (`doc/README.md`, `doc/DOCUMENTATION.md`, `changes.json`, `sw.js`, `README.md`)**:
      - Synchronized under version `v2.53.16`.
      - Archived prompt session records in `doc/prompts/36. Classroom Shortcut FAB, Navbar GitHub Button & Mobile Footer Icons/` with `transcript_full.jsonl`, `conversation.md`, `summary.md`, and companion walkthrough `36.2 Walkthrough - Visitor Mode, DptCoor Permissions, Task Reset & UI Polish.md`.

  - Re-syncing `transcript_full.jsonl`, `conversation.md`, and `summary.md` in `doc/prompts/36. Classroom Shortcut FAB, Navbar GitHub Button & Mobile Footer Icons/` before closing the turn.

---

### 3. Key Findings
- **HTML Nesting Bug in Footer**: Previous turn edit accidentally nested `<a href="...">` inside `<a href="...">` with raw unescaped `<a href="#" id="footer-changelog-link" <a href="#" id="footer-changelog-link"`. The browser DOM parser repaired this by creating duplicate anchor nodes in the DOM tree, displaying "Source Code Source Code" and "What's New What's New". Removing the outer nested anchor and raw text fixed the duplication completely.
- **Semester Auto-Completion Lifecycle**: By setting `isNoDeadline: true` and default `deadline = Utils.getSemesterEnd(createdAt)` on creation, tasks can naturally participate in standard deadline comparisons while displaying descriptive "End of Semester" UI labels. On semester transition, checking `now > semesterEnd` cleanly shifts them to completed rather than destroying task history.

---

### 4. Errors & Fixes
1. *PowerShell Wildcard Escaping with `[oU1TS]`*:
   - *Error*: PowerShell failed with `Cannot find path because it includes characters not valid in a path` or treats `[oU1TS]` as a character set.
   - *Fix*: Always use `-LiteralPath` or `.NET` methods `[System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory(...)` and `[System.IO.File]::Copy(...)`.
2. *Duplicate Catch Block in `js/core/db.js`*:
   - *Error*: `node --check js/core/db.js` threw `SyntaxError: Unexpected token '.'` at line 953 due to an extra `catch (error)` block during edit.
   - *Fix*: Inspected lines 935–965 with `read_file` and removed the duplicate block. `node --check` passed cleanly afterwards.
3. *Node Script Missing Path Resolution in PowerShell Working Directory*:
   - *Error*: `node -e "JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('changes.json'))"` failed with `ENOENT` because PowerShell's working directory was `C:\WINDOWS\System32\...`.
   - *Fix*: Passed explicit absolute forward-slash path `d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/changes.json`.

# Session Summary - 36. Classroom Shortcut FAB, Navbar GitHub Button & Mobile Footer Icons

## Metadata
- **Session Index**: 36
- **Conversation ID**: `b72c1402-0b1e-42a7-a81f-3e22e5e1408d`
- **Session Title**: Classroom Shortcut FAB, Navbar GitHub Button, Mobile Footer Icons & Backlog Audit Execution
- **Current Version**: `v2.53.0 to v2.53.16`
- **Date**: November 2026

---

## User Goals & Directives
1. **Always-Visible Classroom `+` Shortcut**: Make the floating button always present above the Classroom modal and sidebar. (Completed Turn 1)
2. **Top Bar GitHub Button & Mobile Footer Icons**: Icon-only button in the top bar; mobile footer icons only with full credits. (Completed Turn 1)
3. **Approved Backlog Roadmap Execution**:
   - **Item 16 Sub-item 2**: Forgot password link reveals after 2 minutes of idle time.
   - **Item 17**: Department Coordinator ability to edit/delete other faculty tasks within the same department.
   - **Item 19 Sub-item 2**: Admin/CR deletion option for tasks without deadlines, plus auto-deletion after one semester (~180 days).
   - **Item 18**: Visitor mode with client-side only static mock data (zero Firebase/Auth calls) and "Visitor" profile representation.
   - **Item 6 Sub-item 1**: University notices cached in Firestore metadata (`metadata/uni_notices`) for fast loading without cold server delays.
   - **Item 14 Sub-item 3**: Mobile notifications fix prioritizing `ServiceWorkerRegistration.showNotification()`.
   - **Items 4 & 9**: Desktop login card styling and resolution-aware scaling.
   - **Items 12 & 14 Sub-item 1**: Documentation taxonomy in `doc/README.md` and detailed design references in `doc/DOCUMENTATION.md`.

---

## Key Technical Decisions & Architecture
1. **Client-Side Visitor Architecture**:
   - Implemented `js/features/visitor-data.js` containing rich static datasets.
   - Implemented `startVisitorMode()` and `exitVisitorMode()` in `App`.
   - Explicitly bypassed Firestore reads in `loadDashboardData()` and mutations in `handleAddTask()`, `openEditTaskModal()`, `handleDeleteTask()`, and `handleResetTasks()`.
   - Allowed in-memory interactive task completions for demo purposes.
2. **Department Coordinator Security & UI Scoping**:
   - Added `(isDptCoor() && resource.data.department == getUserDepartment())` in `firestore.rules` under `/tasks/{taskId}`.
   - Extended `UI.renderTasks()` and `UI.renderTaskCard()` with `isDptCoor` and `userDepartment` parameters to conditionally display edit/delete buttons for departmental faculty tasks.
3. **Semester Tracking & Auto-Completion of No-Deadline Tasks**:

## Turn 3: Visitor Mode, DptCoor Permissions, Task Reset & UI Polish (Backlog Implementation)

2. **Department Coordinator Permissions**: Updated irestore.rules, js/core/ui.js, and js/core/app.js allowing Department Coordinators (isDptCoor) to edit and delete faculty tasks within their matching department.
3. **No-Deadline Tasks Cleanup & Auto-Deletion**: Updated DB.resetOldTasks and App.handleResetTasks to prompt for deleting no-deadline tasks and automatically delete tasks older than 180 days (~1 semester).
4. **Forgot Password 2-Minute Idle Timer**: Implemented startForgotPasswordIdleTimer() and clearForgotPasswordIdleTimer() in App that reveals #forgot-password-container after 2 minutes of inactivity on the login view.
5. **Mobile Notification Constructor Fix**: Checked 'serviceWorker' in navigator and prioritized egistration.showNotification across 
otification-manager.js, resolving TypeError: Illegal constructor on mobile devices.
6. **University Notices Firestore Metadata Caching**: Pre-checked Firestore document metadata/uni_notices for low-latency notice retrieval without waiting for server wakeups, automatically updating when an Admin refreshes notices.
7. **Desktop Login Window Styling & Resolution Scaling**: Refined .auth-card on desktop screens (min-width: 992px) with an elevated container, border, shadow, and fine-grained --app-scale breakpoints.
8. **Documentation Directory Index & Design References**: Created doc/README.md taxonomy and expanded doc/DOCUMENTATION.md Section 17 with ClickUp, Google Calendar, GitHub, and Bar Chart inspirations, as well as an inventory of all client libraries and the reverted Firebase Storage implementation.
9. **Version Bump**: Consolidated patch release under 2.53.0 to v2.53.16 across sw.js, changes.json, README.md, and doc/DOCUMENTATION.md.

### Step 815 (MODEL - PLANNER_RESPONSE)
*Created at: 2026-11-13T06:48:31Z*

#### Content:
### Summary of Updates & Resolution

#### 1. Footer Links Duplication Fix
- **Root Cause**: An accidental nested anchor tag (`<a href="..." <a href="..."`) in [index.html](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/index.html#L2561-L2577) caused the browser DOM parser to split the anchors and duplicate inner text nodes, displaying repeated `"Source Code Source Code"` and `"What's New What's New"`.
- **Fix**: Cleaned the markup into single semantic anchor elements with unified classes (`.footer-link-text` and `.footer-separator`).

#### 2. Mobile Responsive Footer Display
- **Styles Added** ([css/main.css](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/css/main.css#L1254-L1275)): Under `@media (max-width: 768px)`, `.app-footer .footer-link-text` is set to `display: none !important`.
- **Result**: On mobile devices, the footer links display only the GitHub `<i class="fab fa-github"></i>` and Bullhorn `<i class="fas fa-bullhorn"></i>` icons, while the full creator credit (`© <year> @b1tranger`) remains visible.

#### 3. Semester Tracking & Auto-Completion of No-Deadline Tasks
- **Semester Tracking Engine** ([js/core/utils.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/utils.js#L318-L382)):
  - Added `Utils.getCurrentSemesterInfo(date)` and `Utils.getSemesterEnd(date)`.
  - Spring semester runs January 1 through June 30 (`23:59:59.999`).
  - Fall semester runs July 1 through December 31 (`23:59:59.999`).
- **Default Semester Deadline**:
  - Selecting **"No Deadline"** in [js/core/app.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/app.js) assigns `isNoDeadline: true` and defaults `deadline = Utils.getSemesterEnd(new Date())`.
  - In [js/core/ui.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/ui.js#L435-L540), these tasks render with `Due: End of Semester (MMM DD, YYYY)` and sort naturally after explicit-deadline tasks.
- **Auto-Completion (No Deletion)**:
  - In [js/core/db.js](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/js/core/db.js#L910-L965) (`DB.resetOldTasks()`), tasks whose semester has ended (`now > semesterEnd`) are auto-completed (`isCompleted: true`, `autoCompleted: true`) instead of being deleted.
  - When active dashboard data loads in `App.loadDashboardData()`, any past-semester tasks without explicit deadlines are completed in `userCompletions`.

#### 4. Archival & Verification
- All syntax verified via `node --check` and `JSON.parse` across modified scripts and metadata.
- Archival logs and session documentation synchronized in [doc/prompts/36. Classroom Shortcut FAB, Navbar GitHub Button & Mobile Footer Icons/](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/prompts/36.%20Classroom%20Shortcut%20FAB,%20Navbar%20GitHub%20Button%20&%20Mobile%20Footer%20Icons/).

Command output:
# b1t-Sched - Academic Task Scheduler

> **Academic Task Scheduler** - A modern Single Page Application (SPA) designed for university students, class representatives (CRs), and faculty members to organize and track academic tasks, routines, assignments, exams, and notices with department-specific personalization.

<div align="center">
  <img src="Social-Preview.webp" width="220px" alt="b1t-Sched Logo" style="border-radius: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
  <h1>👉 <a href="https://github.com/b1tranger/b1t-Sched/blob/main/doc/DOCUMENTATION.md">Complete Documentation</a> 👈</h1>
  <p>
    <strong>Current Version:</strong> <code>v2.53.0 to v2.53.16</code> • 
    <strong>Architecture:</strong> Vanilla JS SPA + Firebase Firestore & Auth + PWA
  </p>
</div>

---

## ✨ Features Overview

### 🔐 Authentication & Role Management
- **Flexible Credential Login**: Students can log in with their Student ID (normalized across string, numeric, and formatted inputs with dashes/spaces) or Email. Faculty can log in with their Faculty ID, initials (case-insensitive), or Email.
- **Segmented Role Toggles**: Dedicated Student and Faculty login tabs with strict cross-role enforcement (prevents student accounts from authenticating via the faculty tab and vice versa).
- **Onboarding Role Lockdown**: After initial signup, role identity is locked on the details setup screen, ensuring students cannot bypass section assignments or switch to faculty post-registration.
- **6-Tier Role System**:
  1. `Student` - View personalized section tasks, export tasks, take markdown notes, and sync personal Google Classroom assignments.
  2. `CR` (Class Representative) - Create, edit, and manage section tasks, deadlines, and group notices.
  3. `Faculty` - Create and manage departmental tasks, access Faculty Classroom, and post department-wide notices.
  4. `DptCoor` (Department Coordinator) - Faculty privileges plus account review, approvals, and role elevation within their department.
  5. `DptHead` (Department Head) - Comprehensive departmental oversight and coordinator capabilities.
  6. `Admin` - Complete platform administration, user management, account approvals, role assignments, UID lookups, and the **Admin Role Preview Mode** (simulate any role with a real-time floating indicator).
- **Faculty Self-Registration & Approvals**: Faculty self-register with pending status until approved by an Admin or Department Coordinator via the interactive Approvals modal.
- **Visitor Preview Mode**: Instant client-side exploration using static mock data with zero Firebase network requests (`js/features/visitor-data.js`). Shows sample assignments, labs, events, notices, and profile state without touching the backend.

#### Content:
### Implementation Summary: Desktop Floating "Browse as Visitor" Button

#### 1. Floating Pill Action Button for Desktop
- **Position & Elevation** ([css/main.css](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/css/main.css#L190-L260)):
  - Converted `#visitor-mode-btn` on desktop screens (`@media (min-width: 769px)`) to a fixed floating action button anchored to `bottom: 24px; right: 28px; z-index: 95;`.
  - Styled with pill-shaped rounded corners (`border-radius: 50px`), card background, border, and subtle elevation shadow (`box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`).
  - Added smooth interactive states (`transform: translateY(-2px);` on hover, `translateY(0)` on active click).
  - Integrated theme variations for **Dark Mode** and **Gray Mode**.

#### 2. Resolving Overlap with "FAQ & Support"
- **Clearance Restored**:
  - By taking `#visitor-mode-btn` out of the card's vertical layout flow on desktop, the `.auth-card` height is reduced by ~48px.
  - The centered bouncing scroll indicator (`.login-scroll-indicator` — "FAQ & Support") at `bottom: 24px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);` now has ample vertical clearance with zero visual overlap.

#### 3. Mobile & Login Flow Consistency
- **Mobile Fallback** ([index.html](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/index.html#L310-L320) & [css/main.css](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/css/main.css#L182-L195)):
  - On mobile displays (`<= 768px`), the button remains an inline block button under `.auth-card` directly following the login form buttons.
  - Automatically hidden on mobile when switching to the signup view (`#signup-form`).
  - Automatically hidden once the user logs in or enters visitor mode (via `#login-view` container visibility).

#### 4. Documentation & Archival
- Documented in [changes.json](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/changes.json) and [doc/DOCUMENTATION.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/DOCUMENTATION.md#L1896-L1898) under `v2.53.0 to v2.53.16`.
- Synced prompt transcripts and session files in [doc/prompts/36. Classroom Shortcut FAB, Navbar GitHub Button & Mobile Footer Icons/](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/prompts/36.%20Classroom%20Shortcut%20FAB,%20Navbar%20GitHub%20Button%20&%20Mobile%20Footer%20Icons/).

1: # Repository Rules & Guidelines
2: 
3: ## 1. Changelog & History Maintenance
4: - **Automatic History Updates**: Whenever adding new features, fixing bugs, refactoring components, or altering UI/styles in this codebase, always document the changes in doc/DOCUMENTATION.md (under `## Version History`), changes.json, sw.js#L5-5 (const CACHE_VERSION), and README.md (keeping version, features, and roadmap checklist synchronized with the current release state).
5: - **Placement & Summaries in Documentation**:
6:   - In `doc/DOCUMENTATION.md`, record updates exclusively under `## Version History` as concise, high-level summaries (never at the very top of the file before the Table of Contents).
7:   - Detailed release notes and comprehensive per-change descriptions are maintained in `changes.json` (which powers the in-app changelog modal) and companion walkthrough files in `doc/prompts/`.
8: - **Version Ranges**: Consolidate patch updates into active minor version ranges (e.g., `v2.53.0 to v2.53.8`) in `changes.json` instead of fragmenting each patch into a separate standalone entry.
9: 
10: 
11: ## 2. Mandatory Prompt, Plan & Walkthrough Archiving
12: - **Target Location & Serial Session Folders**:
13:   - All conversation, prompt, plan, and walkthrough records reside inside [`doc/prompts/`](doc/prompts) in dedicated serial folders named with an incrementing major integer prefix:
14:     `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/` (e.g., `doc/prompts/36. Schedule Export Update/`).
15:   - **Determining `<N>`**: Inspect `doc/prompts/` to find the highest existing major integer prefix across both existing session folders and legacy flat `<N>. ...md` files, and assign `N = N_max + 1` for a new conversation session.
16:   - **Session Continuity**: Always update **the same session folder** (`doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/`) on each turn or when resuming an existing conversation; do NOT create a new major folder `<N+1>` per turn.
17: - **Required Files Inside `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/`**:
18:   1. **`transcript_full.jsonl`**: An exact, unmodified UTF-8 copy of `<appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl`. Never truncate, edit, or reformat lines in `transcript_full.jsonl`.
19:   2. **`conversation.md`**: A verbatim Markdown rendering generated directly from `transcript_full.jsonl`, including every step without summarizing or omitting content: metadata (`Conversation ID`, `Session Folder`, and `Continued From` if applicable), all `USER_INPUT.content`, all `PLANNER_RESPONSE.thinking` verbatim, all `PLANNER_RESPONSE.tool_calls` and tool/system outputs (`GENERIC` / `SYSTEM_MESSAGE`), and all `PLANNER_RESPONSE.content` verbatim.
20:   3. **`summary.md` (Conversation Summary Markdown)**: Maintained alongside `transcript_full.jsonl` and `conversation.md` in the same folder, preserving the frontmatter tags comment block at the top and summarizing session metadata, user goals, key technical decisions, files modified, verification results, and outcomes.
21:   4. **Companion Plans & Walkthroughs (Fractional Suffixes Reserved for Plans & Walkthroughs Only)**: Stored in the same `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/` folder:
22:      - Implementation plan: `<N>.1 Implementation Plan - <Plan Title>.md` (dual-write whenever creating/updating `implementation_plan.md` before user review)
23:      - Walkthrough document: `<N>.2 Walkthrough - <Title>.md` (dual-write whenever creating/updating `walkthrough.md` upon completion)
24:      - Subsequent plans/walkthroughs in the same session: `<N>.3 Implementation Plan - ...`, `<N>.4 Walkthrough - ...`, etc.
25: - **Update Cadence (Keeping the Archive Current)**:
26:   - Because the runtime writes a turn's final `PLANNER_RESPONSE` (final `thinking` and `content`) to `transcript_full.jsonl` after the turn finishes:
27:     1. **At the start of each turn (or when continuing from a prior `<conversation-id>`):** Copy `<appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl` to `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/transcript_full.jsonl` and regenerate `conversation.md` so the previous turn's finalized `thinking` and `content` are captured verbatim (and sync the prior conversation's folder if continuing).
28:     2. **Before sending each new final response:** Re-copy `transcript_full.jsonl`, regenerate `conversation.md` to capture all completed steps of the current turn, append the exact final response under `## Pending Final Response (Pre-Commit)` (noting it will be replaced verbatim from `transcript_full.jsonl` on the next sync), and create or update `summary.md` in the same folder.
29: 
30: ## 3. Code Quality & Styling Standards
31: - Follow the established vanilla JavaScript and CSS conventions across the repository.
32: - Avoid introducing unnecessary third-party runtime frameworks or heavy libraries unless explicitly requested.
33: - Maintain responsive design and dark/sky-blue aesthetic consistency across all interactive tools and modals.

# b1t-Sched - Documentation Directory Index

This directory contains the complete technical, architectural, feature, and historical documentation for **b1t-Sched (Academic Task Scheduler)**.

---

## 1. Primary Documentation
- **[DOCUMENTATION.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/DOCUMENTATION.md)**: The authoritative, comprehensive reference manual for the application. Covers system architecture, technology stack, module structure, Firestore data models, API methods, responsive styling, design inspirations, and full version history.

---

## 2. Features Documentation
- **[ADMIN_FEATURES.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/ADMIN_FEATURES.md)**: Guide to Administrator and Department Coordinator tools, including user role toggling (Admin, DptCoor, Faculty, CR, Student, Blocked), Admin Role Preview mode, and bulk semester promotions.
- **[rss-events-integration/](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/rss-events-integration/)**: Specifications for integrating university-wide events and the external UITS Event Raiders syndication feed.
- **[firebaseQueries/](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/firebaseQueries/)**: Firestore querying patterns, indexing requirements, and performance optimizations.

---

## 3. Architecture & Setup
- **[QUICKSTART.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/QUICKSTART.md)**: Quick start guide for running b1t-Sched locally with Live Server or static hosting.
- **[FIREBASE_SETUP.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/FIREBASE_SETUP.md)**: Firebase project configuration, API keys, and environment initialization.
- **[FIREBASE_DATABASE_SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/FIREBASE_DATABASE_SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md)**: Firestore security rules, collection schemas, and indexes.
- **[FIRESTORE_TASK_CHANGES.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/FIRESTORE_TASK_CHANGES.md)**: Evolution of task document schema, completion maps, and role permissions.
- **[REDESIGN_PLAN.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/REDESIGN_PLAN.md)**: Architectural plan for the modular 2.0 rewrite.

---

## 4. Reverted Implementations & Known Limitations
- **Firebase Storage Bucket Uploads (Reverted)**:
  - *Context*: Notes originally attempted to upload attachments to Firebase Cloud Storage (`uploadToFirebaseStorage`).
  - *Reason for Reversion*: Strict free-tier quota limits (5 GB total storage, 1 GB/day bandwidth) and CORS configuration overhead.
  - *Current Solution*: Multi-provider fallback pipeline (`Catbox.moe` primary with 200 MB limit, `Tmpfiles.org` secondary) combined with client-side blob downloads.
- **Mobile Web Notification API Restriction (Known Limitation)**:
  - *Context*: Direct `new Notification(...)` calls fail with an `Illegal constructor` error on mobile operating systems (Android Chrome, iOS Safari).
  - *Current Solution*: Priority resolution via Service Worker (`navigator.serviceWorker.ready -> registration.showNotification`).
- **Device Viewport Auto-Zoom (Known Limitation)**:
  - *Context*: Android and iOS browsers trigger aggressive zoom-in when focusing `<input>` elements with font sizes below `16px`.
  - *Current Solution*: Modal forms enforce `font-size: 16px !important` on mobile, `100dvh` modal viewport clamping, and responsive CSS scaling.

---

## 5. Serial Prompts, Plans & Walkthroughs (AGENTS.md Archives)
All prompt sessions, implementation plans, and post-execution walkthroughs are systematically recorded in **[`doc/prompts/`](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/prompts/)**:
- **Session 36**: Classroom Shortcut FAB, Navbar GitHub Button, Mobile Footer Icons & Backlog Audit.
- **Session 35**: Classroom Sync, Modular Architecture, Theming & Authentication.
- **Session 34**: Firebase Task ID, Admin Role Preview Mode, Approvals & Department Notices.
- **Sessions 1-33**: Historical feature evolutions and bug fixes.

Lines: 322
# Chat Conversation - 31. Offline Banner Dedicated Layout Space and Content Push Down

Note: _This is a comprehensive record of the pair programming session covering the fix to convert the offline indicator banner from an overlay into a dedicated layout space that dynamically pushes all top-level website content, navbars, sidebars, and login views downward without obscuring or overlapping any UI elements._

---

### User Input

```
the offline banner for this project@[c:\Users\gsmur\Documents\GitHub\[oU1TS]\b1t-Sched\js\offline-indicator.js:L39-L60] shows as overlay and hides some website contents at the top. Make it have dedicated space so when offline, the banner pushes the website content down and all the website content is shown as intended.
```

---

### AI Thought

1. **Analyze User Issue & Root Cause**:
   - **Target Component**: `#offline-indicator` ("You're offline. Showing cached content.") defined in `js/offline-indicator.js` and styled in `css/components.css`.
   - **Problem**: When the browser goes offline, the offline banner was styled with `position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 10001;`. Because it acted as a floating overlay with hardcoded height assumptions in CSS (`top: 44px` / `30px` for navbar and `margin-top: 44px` / `30px` for `.main-content`), it had multiple flaws:
     1. On the unauthenticated Login/Auth screen (`#navbar` hidden), the login container had negative top margins pulling it behind the banner, obscuring the logo and header text.
     2. On mobile/compact screens, responsive text wrapping caused the banner height to exceed the hardcoded 30px offset (reaching 48px–60px), causing the banner to clip and overlap the top half of the navbar, logo, title, and buttons.
     3. Opening sidebar drawers (`.events-sidebar`, `.notice-sidebar`, `.classroom-sidebar`) or the mobile nav menu while offline resulted in their top headers and close controls being clipped behind the fixed banner.
     4. Desktop sticky sidebar (`.dashboard-sidebar`) was not dynamically offset, causing misalignment when offline.

2. **Formulate Solution Strategy**:
   - **Dynamic Height via CSS Custom Property (`--offline-banner-height`)**:
     - Manage a root CSS variable `--offline-banner-height: 0px;`.
     - In `js/offline-indicator.js`:
       - Measure the rendered height (`offsetHeight`) of `#offline-indicator` whenever it is shown.
       - Set `--offline-banner-height` dynamically on `document.documentElement`.
       - Implement a `ResizeObserver` on `#offline-indicator` (with fallback window `resize` listener) to reactively recalculate height whenever text wraps or the viewport dimensions change.
       - Clean up listeners and reset `--offline-banner-height` to `0px` on `hideOfflineIndicator()`.
     - Ensure the `#offline-indicator` is prepended at the top of `<body>` rather than appended at the end.
   - **Dedicated Layout Offsets in CSS (`css/components.css`)**:
     - Configure `body.offline-active .navbar` to use `top: var(--offline-banner-height, 42px)`.
     - Update `body.offline-active .main-content` padding-top across desktop (`calc(80px + var(--offline-banner-height, 42px))`), tablet (`calc(66px + var(--offline-banner-height, 42px))`), and mobile (`calc(60px + var(--offline-banner-height, 34px))`).
     - Adjust mobile nav drawer `.nav-center` top offset to `calc(60px + var(--offline-banner-height, 34px))`.
     - Reset `.auth-container` and `.set-details-container` top margins (`margin-top: 0 !important; min-height: calc(100vh - var(--offline-banner-height, 42px));`) so login and onboarding forms are fully visible and push down smoothly.
     - Adjust `.dashboard-sidebar`, `.events-sidebar`, `.notice-sidebar`, and `.classroom-sidebar` `top` and `height` properties when `body.offline-active`.
   - **Smooth Transitions (`css/navbar.css`, `css/main.css`)**:
     - Added `transition: top var(--transition-fast, 0.2s ease);` to `.navbar`.
     - Added `transition: padding-top var(--transition-fast, 0.2s ease);` to `.main-content`.
   - **HTML Static Inclusion (`index.html`)**:
     - Inserted `#offline-indicator` with accessibility attributes (`role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`) at the top of `<body>`.

await user.sendEmailVerification(actionCodeSettings);

Now after clicking the verification link, Firebase verifies the email and **redirects back to your app's login page** — not its own generic page.

**`sw.js`** — Added explicit bypass rules so the service worker **never intercepts** Firebase auth action URLs or URLs with `oobCode`/`apiKey` params. Cache version bumped to `v2.42.2` to force all PWA users to get the new SW.

### One required manual step in Firebase Console

> [!IMPORTANT]
> You **must add your app's domain** to the **Authorized domains** list in Firebase Console, otherwise the `continueUrl` redirect will be blocked.
>
> Go to: **Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains**
> Add: `b1t-sched.web.app` (and any custom domain you use)
>
> `firebaseapp.com` is already there by default. If your app is only hosted on that domain, this step may not be needed — but if you use `web.app` or a custom domain, it is required.
14 tail:
1. Go to **[Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials?project=b1t-sched)**
2. Find and click on the API key: `---`
3. Under **Application restrictions → HTTP referrers**, add these entries:

```
https://b1t-sched.firebaseapp.com/*
https://b1t-sched.web.app/*
```

4. Click **Save**

> [!NOTE]
> Changes to API key restrictions can take **up to 5 minutes** to propagate. After saving, wait a few minutes before testing the verification link again.

No code changes needed — the `auth.js` and `sw.js` fixes from earlier are correct. This is purely a Google Cloud config step.

     - In `index.html`, extracted `#visitor-mode-btn` from inside `#login-form` into `.auth-card`, removing inline margins and adding class `.visitor-mode-btn`.

     - On mobile (`<= 768px`), retained natural inline block button flow below the login form while auto-hiding when switched to `#signup-form`.
  2. **Prompt Taxonomy Reorganization (Sessions 1 to 36)**:
     - Unpacked and structured all 36 historical sessions into individual serial directories under `doc/prompts/`:
       - `1.` through `12.`: Formed from `1-12/` files (`prompt_1.md` through `prompt_12.md`).

  3. **Resolved Git Commit Failure**:
     - Analyzed `temp/git-commit-1.md` lines 1346–1348, identifying the exact error:
       `error: open("doc/prompts/33.../33...md"): Filename too long`
       `fatal: adding files failed`
     - Root Cause: Path length of `doc/prompts/33. LocalSend Integration.../33. LocalSend Integration....md` was 266 characters, exceeding Windows default `MAX_PATH` (260 characters).
     - Fixes applied:
       a. Enabled long paths in Git: `git config core.longpaths true`.

     - Ran `git add -A --dry-run` and `git add -A` with exit code 0.

---

### 3. Key Findings
- **Windows MAX_PATH (260 chars) vs Git**:
  - On Windows, Git fails with `Filename too long` during `git add` if a file path exceeds 260 characters unless `core.longpaths = true` is configured.
  - Redundant nesting of descriptive folder names and identical file names (e.g. `doc/prompts/33. <long-title>/33. <long-title>.md`) easily breaches the 260-char ceiling. Using standard `conversation.md` and `summary.md` inside `<N>. <Title>/` keeps path lengths well below limits.
- **Sandbox Git Restriction**:
  - The local sandboxed environment denies write permissions to `.git/` (`EPERM: operation not permitted` on `index.lock`). Git commands modifying the repository index must run outside the sandbox (`BypassSandbox: true`), which succeeded cleanly.

---

1. *Task `task-840` / `git grep` Syntax Error*:

2. *Session 35 Directory Recursion in `reorganize_prompts.js`*:
   - *Error*: `EPERM: operation not permitted, copyfile ...\35. ... -> ...\35. ...\35. ...`.
   - *Fix*: Added `fs.statSync(path.join(baseDir, f)).isFile()` to filter out the newly created folder itself before copying files.
3. *Git Add / Commit Failure (`temp/git-commit-1.md`)*:
   - *Error*: `error: open("doc/prompts/33.../33...md"): Filename too long` -> `fatal: adding files failed`.
   - *Fix*: Enabled `git config core.longpaths true`, removed the redundant duplicate long-path file in session 33, and executed `git add -A`.
